# ScaleSafe

> ScaleSafe is compliance operations software for SEBI-regulated investment advisers (IA), research analysts (RA), portfolio management services (PMS) and alternative investment funds (AIF). It tracks obligations, owners, deadlines, evidence and inspection readiness, and publishes plain-language notes on SEBI and MeitY updates.

Source content may be cited with a link back to the page. Training on this content is not permitted (see Terms of Use).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://scalesafe.co.in/): product overview, registration types and the enquiry form
- [Accredit your investors in-house](https://scalesafe.co.in/accredited-investor-desk/): SEBI's manager-led accredited investor route
